tasks.label: Story similarity probe
Scoring probe
tasks.command: node -e "const {EventRepository}=require('./src/repositories/eventRepository'); const {AnalysisRepository}=require('./src/repositories/analysisRepository'); const {StoryRepository}=require('./src/repositories/storyRepository'); const {StoryClusteringService}=require('./src/services/storyClusteringService'); const {storagePath,analysisStoragePath,storyStoragePath}=require('./src/config'); const {FinancialNLPipeline}=require('./src/nlp/nlpPipeline'); const {SourceAdapterRegistry}=require('./src/adapters/sourceRegistry'); const {IngestionService}=require('./src/services/ingestionService'); const repository=new EventRepository(storagePath); const analysisRepository=new AnalysisRepository(analysisStoragePath); const storyRepository=new StoryRepository(storyStoragePath); const service=new IngestionService({repository,sourceRegistry:new SourceAdapterRegistry()}); const storyService=new StoryClusteringService({eventRepository:repository,analysisRepository,storyRepository}); const e1=service.ingestOne({source:'news',source_event_id:'s1',title:'Company X faces regulatory investigation',content:'Authorities are investigating Company X after compliance concerns.',published_at:new Date().toISOString(),language:'en',event_type:'regulatory_action'}); const a1=new FinancialNLPipeline().process(e1); analysisRepository.save(a1); const e2=service.ingestOne({source:'major_news',source_event_id:'s2',title:'Regulator launches probe into Company X',content:'A regulator launched a probe into Company X after compliance issues were identified.',published_at:new Date().toISOString(),language:'en',event_type:'regulatory_action'}); const a2=new FinancialNLPipeline().process(e2); analysisRepository.save(a2); console.log('a1',JSON.stringify(a1.entities)); console.log('a2',JSON.stringify(a2.entities)); console.log('similarity', storyService.getSimilarityScore(e1,a1,e2,a2)); const match=storyService.findMatchingStory(e2,a2); console.log('match', match && match.story && {id:match.story.id,title:match.story.title,score:match.score,source_count:match.story.source_count}); console.log('stories', storyService.listStories());"

tasks.label: Debug story state
tasks.command: node -e "const { app, resetIngestionForTests } = require('./src/app'); const request = require('supertest'); (async () => { resetIngestionForTests(); const makeEvent = (source, sourceEventId, overrides = {}) => ({ source, source_event_id: sourceEventId, title: 'Company X faces regulatory investigation', content: 'Authorities are investigating Company X in connection with a financial compliance issue.', published_at: new Date().toISOString(), language: 'en', event_type: 'regulatory_action', ...overrides }); const articleA = makeEvent('news', 'story-1', { title: 'Company X faces regulatory investigation', content: 'Regulators investigate Company X after internal compliance concerns.' }); const articleB = makeEvent('major_news', 'story-2', { title: 'Regulator launches probe into Company X', content: 'A regulator launched a probe into Company X after compliance issues were identified.' }); const first = await request(app).post('/api/v1/events').send(articleA); await request(app).post(`/api/v1/events/${first.body.data.id}/analyze`); const second = await request(app).post('/api/v1/events').send(articleB); await request(app).post(`/api/v1/events/${second.body.data.id}/analyze`); const service = require('./src/app').storyClusteringService; const stories = await service.clusterEvents([first.body.data.id, second.body.data.id]); console.log(JSON.stringify(stories, null, 2)); const list = await request(app).get('/api/v1/stories'); console.log(JSON.stringify(list.body, null, 2)); })().catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });"
